text:
alana (PM): quick sync. proposal: remove the A/B experiment framework from the MVP cut to keep the ship date. MVP will include a simple canary routing + feature-flagged rollout; full experiment UI + analytics land in v1. this lets us deliver the core latency/cost improvements now. reactions? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ravi (Eng): sounds pragmatic. experiment framework was adding 4-5 dev weeks (analytics hooks + SDK). canary + flag is ~1 sprint.

zoe (Design): UX note: removing experiment UI means customers lose the self-serve split controls. we should prepare a clear comms blurb and an enterprise path for managed experiments. minimal FAQ + banner.

mika (Data): analytics impact: without the experiment layer we'll have less granularity for attribution. we can collect canary cohort tags and run offline A/B analysis, but not in-product dashboards. needs a telemetry schema change.

owen (SRE): canary approach ok from infra. we need SLO gate: canary must be automatically rolled back if error rate or latency regresses beyond thresholds. otherwise risk of noisy launch.

sasha (Customer Success): biggest customers expecting self-serve experiments will ask. propose we offer 2 managed experiments as service during MVP if they pay/support. gives them runway and buys us time.

alana (PM): agree. summarized new plan: 
- MVP: canary routing + feature flags + automated rollback rules; no self-serve experiment UI.
- v1: full experiment framework with per-tenant split controls, real-time analytics, and console UX.
- enterprise: managed experiments for up to 2 customers in MVP as a paid service.

ravi (Eng): implementation notes: 
1) canary routing: simple hash-based cohort tag (10% -> canary) at the edge router.
2) flag service: use existing feature-flag infra (FFS) with a new model-route flag.
3) telemetry: emit cohort tag and model-version on all spans.
4) automated rollback: SRE should wire alerts to close the flag on trigger.

Code snippet for canary tag (pseudo):
```
# edge router
if hash(user_id) % 100 < 10:
  request.headers['x-cohort'] = 'canary'
else:
  request.headers['x-cohort'] = 'control'
```

zoe (Design): comms: short banner + FAQ + one-pager for enterprise managed experiments. i'll draft the language and banner copy.

mika (Data): offline analysis plan: we'll run cohort-level A/B using the cohort tag and baseline prompt sets. need 2 weeks of post-launch data before concluding. add an entry to the evals runbook.

owen (SRE): automated rollback criteria suggestion: 
- 5xx rate increase > 0.5% absolute AND 2x baseline for 5m
- p95 latency increase > 300ms over baseline for 5m
We'll implement the flag kill-switch in FFS and a prometheus alert to trigger remediation runbook.

sasha (Customer Success): i'll pre-empt top 3 customers with a note and offer managed experiment seats. i'll also draft support playbook for how to request one.

alana (PM): new launch checklist (MVP-lite): 
- canary routing implemented and load-tested
- feature-flag gate for model routing in place
- telemetry emits cohort & model-version tags (validated)
- automated rollback alerts + drill complete
- comms banner + support playbook ready
- 2 managed-experiment slots defined and priced

ravi (Eng): timeline: we can do canary + flag + basic telemetry in 3 weeks. automated rollback wiring + runbook in parallel with SRE.

zoe (Design): i'll have banner + FAQ draft by EOD Friday.

mika (Data): i'll scaffold the offline analysis notebook and baseline prompt sets by next Tue.

owen (SRE): will create alerts and run the rollback drill during staging deploys.

sasha (Customer Success): will reach out to top customers and list 2 candidates by Monday.

alana (PM): action owners: 
- alana: update milestone tracker & notify execs (today)
- ravi: implement canary + flag + telemetry (3w)
- owen: automated rollback + alerts (this sprint)
- mika: offline A/B plan & evals (next Tue)
- zoe: comms + banner + FAQ (EOD Fri)
- sasha: customer outreach & managed-experiment offers (Mon)

deploy-bot: deployment queued: mvp-canary/2026-04-06 -> staging (checks pending)

alana (PM): if no objections i'll formalize the cut in the milestone tracker and lock the launch date. call if concerns. :white_check_mark:
